# Version 4.152.0 (Unreleased)
> **Small performance touch-ups**

## Highlights

Trims a couple of hot-path allocations in HarfBuzz shaping and tag formatting.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Faster HarfBuzz shaping and tag formatting** — Avoids a defensive Feature[] copy in Font.Shape and removes char boxing from SKFourByteTag/Tag.ToString, reducing allocations on the shaping hot path.
